name: Right solution per sub-agent, detail only when opened
purpose: The tree shows each sub-agent on the solution it works on in the right hierarchy, stays free of field detail until a solution is opened, then carries that solution's named fields and connections, and an unknown solution is handled.
record: One number: the share of scripted cases right, balanced with time by [balance.structure_in_view]; weights and budgets fixed in esoi.toml before any arm was scored. Kinds of case (evaluation/structure_in_view/build_cases.py): hierarchy (the nesting of solutions, including a sub-agent with no solution and two agents on one solution), agent (the solution each sub-agent is on, its state and latest activity), collapsed (no detail and none of the records' field text in the data), expanded (purpose, approach, metric and latest value, selected implementation and milestones; problems, ideals and delegates with their fields; only the opened node) and unknown (a solution id the records lack, with and without records). All free: events and a small invented set of records are written by hand.
disadvantages: The records are a few invented rows, so it shows the rules hold, not that a real session's tree is clear; whether a person finds the right level of detail is the later stage. It cannot see a solution the AI works on with no agent reporting it.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the free scripted cases pass] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a real solution-worker session is viewed against the hub's own records and a person reads it] > free [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the arm was recorded on the same cases]
